snippet.title: Zeepkist - The Workshop Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy Zeepkist! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1440670/Zeepkist/
Follow Zeepkist on Twitter! - https://twitter.com/ZeepkistGame

Trailer music by Duncan Steven: https://linktr.ee/duncansteven

--

It's finally here! Steam Workshop support for Zeepkist!! You can now upload your own levels to the Steam Workshop, so everyone can download and play them! And if you're not the creative type, then Workshop will allow you to have an endless supply of new content!

Levels can be uploaded through the built-in uploader tool, allowing you to upload one or multiple levels (as a level pack) at a time!

Levels can be downloaded from the Zeepkist Steam Workshop:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1440670/workshop/
